change_summary: Add fail-closed standalone MLB game input shape guard and prevent different sportsbooks being treated as a same-book reciprocal quote pair. Explicit book added to card output. No changes to formulas, v5, risk, historical predictions or releases.
assumptions: Lineup and starter IDs in a CSV are structural data, not independently authenticated original pregame confirmations.
Missing matchup inputs are blocked instead of silently using averages; this candidate is not a validation of accurate MLB probabilities.
Separate books may each have their own valid exact-market price pair but two books cannot supply one reciprocal pair.
No authenticated sportsbook original bytes or fresh market calibration is supplied by these synthetic tests.
